sentences.text: Kunpengornis represents an extinct genus of euornithean birds.
The genus name fuses the Chinese mythic creature Kunpeng with the Greek term for bird.
Its only known species, K. anhuimusei, honors the museum that safeguards the holotype.
A farmer uncovered the holotype near Lamadong in Jianchang County, Liaoning Province, China.
He donated the specimen to the Anhui Geological Museum in 2023.
Fish bones recovered from its abdominal cavity reveal a piscivorous diet.
The genus Kunpengornis was erected by Huang and colleagues in 2026.
Phylogenetic work places it within Euornithes as the sister taxon to Piscivoravis.
The clade that includes Kunpengornis diverged after Yanornithidae but before Gansuidae and Ornithuromorpha.
Euornithes serves as the broader group encompassing this genus.
It is assigned to the class Reptilia.
Kunpengornis inhabited Liaoning Province during the Early Cretaceous Aptian age.
Its age range spans from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
